projects.name: B-ANAN
projects.author: Zephaniah Chizulu
projects.description: A Business Intelligence (BI) platform for forecasting banana prices across multiple Latin American countries using hybrid machine learning models (SARIMAX, XGBoost, Random Forest). Integrates WorldBank API data and OpenAI GPT-3.5 for AI-driven insights.
achievements: Built hybrid forecasting models combining SARIMAX, XGBoost, and Random Forest for multi-country price prediction
Integrated WorldBank API for real-time economic data and OpenAI GPT-3.5 for AI-powered insights
Developed full-stack BI platform using React (TypeScript) frontend and FastAPI backend with Supabase database

projects.name: PDFreak AI
projects.author: Zephaniah Chizulu
projects.description: An AI-powered PDF threat detection system achieving 83.1% F1-Score using Mistral 7B with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture. Reduces SOC analyst triage time by 40% through intelligent document analysis.
achievements: Achieved 83.1% F1-Score in AI-powered PDF malware detection using Mistral 7B with RAG architecture
Reduced SOC analyst triage time by 40% through intelligent automated threat analysis
Built containerized solution with FastAPI backend and React/Tailwind frontend for SOC deployment
